name: dsh-mcp-manager
description: DSH MCP manager: Web sidebar 'MCP' entry; panel groups MCP servers by status (running / connecting / configured / failed); quick add via stdio / streamable-http forms and paste-mcpServers-JSON import. Tools of connected servers register as mcp__<server>__<tool> for direct model calls.

scripts.build: node scripts/build/clean-lib.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build/bundle-host.ts .
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm test

bundle.bannerJs:
import { createRequire as __mcpManagerRequire } from "node:module";
const require = __mcpManagerRequire(import.meta.url);
